ProductionLog.title: ProductionLog
ProductionLog.description: Hourly production UPH log record for Production Line A or Production Line B.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this production log record.

timeRange.description: Hourly timestamp string in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm format.

onlineQty.description: Online station completed quantity in this hour.

offlineQty.description: Offline SFG station completed quantity in this hour.

targetOnlineQty.description: Target online UPH for this hour.

targetOfflineQty.description: Target offline UPH for this hour.

ngQty.description: Defective or NG units recorded in this hour.

downtimeMinutes.description: Unplanned downtime duration in minutes during this hour.

operatorNote.description: Shift supervisor or operator remark for this hourly slot.

status.description: Computed health status for this hourly record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated.

ProductionAlert.title: ProductionAlert
ProductionAlert.description: Process anomaly or UPH drop alert for a production line.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this alert record.

timeRange.description: Hourly slot associated with the anomaly.

line.description: Manufacturing line where the anomaly occurred.

title.description: Short summary title of the anomaly.

rootCause.description: Documented root cause and corrective action.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the alert was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the alert was last updated.

LineConfig.title: LineConfig
LineConfig.description: Target UPH and anomaly threshold configuration for a production line.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this configuration.

minOnlineThreshold.description: Minimum online UPH before triggering an anomaly alert.

minOfflineThreshold.description: Minimum offline UPH before triggering an anomaly alert.

maxImbalanceGap.description: Maximum allowed difference between online and offline quantity per hour.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the config was last updated.

/production_logs/{logId}.description: Stores hourly UPH production records for Line A and Line B.

/production_alerts/{alertId}.description: Stores manufacturing process anomaly alerts and resolution logs.

/line_configs/{configId}.description: Stores per-line target UPH and anomaly detection thresholds.
